boundary_note: Bounded first pass for all five frozen records in the Confederate Heartland Offensive. Preserve per-engagement dates; the live NPS campaign heading (June-October 1862) does not replace any battle interval. Opening personnel and exact effective command boundaries remain unresolved. Draft claims do not alter model inputs.

claims.rationale: No inspected return establishes matched personnel at a common opening boundary. Imported numerical estimates remain unchanged; this pass does not validate them as simultaneous opening forces.

claims.value: The frozen casualty text reads 4,862 total (US 4,148; CS 714). The live NPS field reads 4433 total (US 4148; CS 285;).
claims.rationale: Original casualty returns were not inspected; preserve totals, categories, cutoffs and differences. No canonical reconciliation or casualty-based opening count; related actions must not be added without resolving population overlap. Category composition, including any treatment of surrendered troops, was not inspected.

open_questions: Original telegrams, surrender terms, returns, casualty categories and the September 13/14 demand chronology remain deferred after the bounded pass.
NPS/CWSAC is one family; Cist is one interested retrospective Union staff history. Quoted reports and participant accounts inside Cist are not additional independently inspected families.
No automatic commander attribution, causal campaign score, morale/readiness number or battle/campaign double counting.
